### Selected Story
The GPS change users did not have to install

### Story Progression
- **Context:** Selective Availability deliberately degraded public GPS signals for national security.
- **Development:** In May 2000 the US government stopped using it at President Bill Clinton’s direction to make civil and commercial GPS more useful worldwide.
- **Development:** In September 2007 the government announced it would procure the future GPS III generation without the feature.
- **Endpoint:** The 2007 procurement decision was not the 2000 operational switch.
